readings: Considering only films whose `replacement_cost` is strictly greater than 20.99, compute for each `rating` the average `rental_duration` and the average of the per-film `rental_rate` / `replacement_cost` ratio, ignoring missing values. Then return one row with the unweighted average of those per-rating average durations and the unweighted average of those per-rating average ratios, in that order and unrounded.

Considering only films whose `replacement_cost` is greater than or equal to 20.99 (20.99 itself is included), compute for each `rating` the average `rental_duration` and the average of the per-film `rental_rate` / `replacement_cost` ratio, ignoring missing values. Then return one row with the unweighted average of those per-rating average durations and the unweighted average of those per-rating average ratios, in that order and unrounded.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_duration), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
SELECT AVG(avg_dur), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_dur,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
